rows.words:
BEGIN
Option 3, as an amendment to (R368)(1) on the author’s word: one standing change, VERSION moved, bounding the readers behind N2, N4, N5 and S3 at the next act’s opening commit (49c58344) when a close runs inside a later act. Its controls: b757’s four scores read HELD as at step [9]; a planted b757 commit after its lock still read as a violation. Then step [22] again, then [23] to [25]. The ceiling stays 16 hours; if it is passed, (7) carries as (2) orders.
END
